---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Problem Statement
Describe the problem or limitation this feature would solve. Is it related to an existing issue?

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of how you propose to implement or handle this feature.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, sketches, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Priority
- [ ] Low (nice to have)
- [ ] Medium (should have)
- [ ] High (must have)

## Who would benefit?
Describe who would benefit from this feature (gamers, mobile users, etc.).
